documents.title: Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Intimation
Shareholder Meeting / Postal Ballot-Outcome of AGM

analysis.summary: Bhansali Engineering Polymers Limited reported a 53.3% YoY increase in revenue from operations to ₹ 472.2 crores for Q1 FY27, with EBITDA rising 44.5% YoY to ₹ 92.3 crores. The company is executing an ongoing capex of approximately ₹ 200 crore to expand ABS capacity from 75,000 MTPA to 100,000 MTPA, fully funded through internal accruals. Commissioning of the expanded capacity is targeted by 30th September 2026, with optimal capacity utilization expected by the end of FY28. In FY26, Bhansali Engineering Polymers reported revenue from operations of INR 1,276.0 crores and an EBITDA of INR 255.2 crores with margins at 20.0%. The company is executing an ongoing ₹200 crore capex through internal accruals to expand its ABS capacity from 75,000 MTPA to 100,000 MTPA, targeting commissioning by September 2026.

guidance.claim: Optimal utilisation of expanded capacity is expected by the end of FY28.
guidance.quote: Optimal utilisation of expanded capacity expected by end of FY28.

guidance.claim: The commissioning of the enhanced capacity is expected to be completed by the end of September 2026.
guidance.quote: The balance engineering, procurement and construction work is in progress and the commissioning of enhanced capacity is expected to be completed by end of September, 2026.

demand_outlook.claim: Appliances and automotive sectors continue to dominate global demand for ABS resins.
demand_outlook.quote: Appliances and Automotive continue to dominate global demand for ABS resins due to their high impact resistance and aesthetic versatility.

demand_outlook.claim: Robust growth in consumer durables and automotive end-user industries will drive domestic demand for ABS.
demand_outlook.quote: Robust growth in end-user industries like consumer durables (air conditioners, refrigerators) and automotive will drive the domestic demand for ABS.

demand_outlook.claim: Electric vehicle adoption is accelerating consumption as manufacturers prioritize lightweight, high-performance plastics.
demand_outlook.quote: EV (Electric Vehicle) adoption is accelerating consumption as manufacturers prioritize lightweight, high-performance plastics for interior trims and battery housings.

demand_outlook.claim: The global market is shifting toward higher-margin specialty and colored grades.
demand_outlook.quote: The global market is shifting toward specialty & colored grades, moving away from commoditized transparent resins to higher-margin applications.

demand_outlook.claim: The IMD forecast of a normal-to-above-normal monsoon for 2026 is expected to reduce El Niño risk and support rural demand.
demand_outlook.quote: The IMD's June forecast indicates a normal-to-above-normal monsoon for 2026, reducing El Niño risk — a meaningful positive for rural demand and food inflation.

demand_outlook.claim: The long-term outlook for engineering thermoplastics used in household appliances remains positive.
demand_outlook.quote: Accordingly, the long-term outlook for engineering thermoplastics used in household appliances remains positive.

demand_outlook.claim: There is significant scope for growth as ABS consumption in India exceeds the combined output of domestic manufacturers.
demand_outlook.quote: There is immense scope for growth, considering the existing supply and demand mismatch, and knowing the fact that the consumption of ABS in India is voluminously larger as compared to the combined output of the domestic manufacturers.

capex_expansion.claim: Implementation of the capacity expansion from 75,000 TPA to 1,00,000 TPA is progressing well with orders placed for critical equipment.
capex_expansion.quote: The implementation of capacity expansion from existing 75000 TPA to 1,00,000 TPA is progressing well and orders have been placed for critical long delivery equipments.

capex_expansion.claim: Balance engineering, procurement, and construction work for capacity expansion is in progress towards a September 2026 commissioning target.
capex_expansion.quote: The balance engineering, procurement and construction work is in progress and the commissioning of enhanced capacity is expected to be completed by end of September, 2026.

margins_costs.claim: Revenue from operations increased by 53.3% YoY in Q1 FY27 to ₹ 472.2 crores.
margins_costs.quote: Revenue from operations increased by +53.3% YoY in Q1 FY27 to ₹ 472.2 crores, from ₹ 307.9 crores in Q1 FY26.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA grew 44.5% YoY in Q1 FY27 to ₹ 92.3 crores, with margins at 19.2%.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA increased by 44.5% YoY in Q1 FY27 to ₹ 92.3 crores, from ₹ 63.9 crores in Q1 FY26, with margins at 19.2% for Q1 FY27 as compared to 20.0% in Q1 FY26.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA increased by 33.1% YoY in Q4 FY26 to INR 74.3 crores with margins at 21.8%, while full-year FY26 EBITDA reached INR 255.2 crores.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA increased by 33.1% YoY in Q4 FY26 to INR 74.3 crores, with margins at 21.8%; for FY26, EBITDA grew by 1.3% to INR 255.2 crores, with margins at 20.0%.

margins_costs.claim: The operating margin for FY 2025-26 reached 19.42% compared to 17.43% in FY 2024-25, and net profit margin reached 14.14%.
margins_costs.quote: The operating margin for FY 2025-26 was 19.42 % as compared to 17.43 % for FY 2024-25, whereas the net profit margin stood at 14.14 % as compared to 12.86 % for the previous FY.

orders_capacity.claim: The company operates two manufacturing facilities located at Abu Road in Rajasthan and Satnoor in Madhya Pradesh.
orders_capacity.quote: Operates two manufacturing facilities at Abu Road (Rajasthan) and Satnoor (Madhya Pradesh), supported by an in-house R&D centre at Abu Road.

orders_capacity.claim: The company achieved a production volume of 71,601 TPA against an installed capacity of 75,000 TPA during FY 2025-26.
orders_capacity.quote: During FY 2025-26, the Company achieved production volume of 71601 TPA against installed capacity of 75,000 TPA.

orders_capacity.claim: Sales volume for FY 2025-26 stood at 71,501 TPA.
orders_capacity.quote: Sales volume stood at 71501 TPA (Previous year - 74381 TPA).

capital_allocation.claim: The company maintains a healthy dividend payout ratio of approximately 50%+.
capital_allocation.quote: Healthy dividend payout (~50%+)* reflects disciplined capital allocation and shareholder returns.

capital_allocation.claim: The company operates with a debt-free balance sheet.
capital_allocation.quote: Debt-free balance sheet ensures zero financial risk and high resilience.

capital_allocation.claim: Growth is self-funded through consistent positive operating cash flows without external capital reliance.
capital_allocation.quote: Consistent positive operating cash flows (CFO) support self-funded growth without reliance on external capital.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board declared three interim dividends of Re. 1 each and recommended a final dividend of Re. 1 per equity share for FY 2025-26.
capital_allocation.quote: Continuing with the practice of rewarding shareholders, the Board declared three Interim Dividends, each of Re.1/- (collectively 300%) per Equity shares of Re.1/- and recommended a Final Dividend of Re.1/- (100 %) per Equity Share for the Financial Year Ended 31st March, 2026.

capital_allocation.claim: The company continues to operate as a zero-debt entity.
capital_allocation.quote: The Company continues to enjoy the status of a “Zero Debt Company”.

capital_allocation.claim: The company expects to sustain its business operations through internal accruals.
capital_allocation.quote: There was no change in financing pattern and the Company would be able to sustain its business operations through internal accruals.

risks_headwinds.claim: The domestic ABS business is exposed to foreign exchange risks as key raw materials like Styrene and Acrylonitrile are entirely imported.
risks_headwinds.quote: The ABS business in India is exposed to the risk of foreign exchange fluctuations, as the key raw materials viz. ‘Styrene’ and ‘Acrylonitrile’ are import dependent, as there is no indigenous producer for these monomers.

risks_headwinds.claim: Higher trade barriers, regional conflicts, and fiscal pressures pose downside risks to global economic growth.
risks_headwinds.quote: However, higher trade barriers, regional conflicts and fiscal pressures across several economies continue to pose downside risks to growth.

management_commitments.claim: Optimal utilisation of expanded capacity is expected by the end of FY28.
management_commitments.quote: Optimal utilisation of expanded capacity expected by end of FY28.

management_commitments.claim: The company expects to complete the commissioning of its capacity expansion to 1,00,000 TPA by the end of September 2026.
management_commitments.quote: The balance engineering, procurement and construction work is in progress and the commissioning of enhanced capacity is expected to be completed by end of September, 2026.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
